**Observation Log:**

[FACT] The user is planning to make spaghetti for dinner.

[FACT] The user is using homemade pasta sauce from scratch that they made last week.

[PREFERENCE] The user wants tips on how to cook the perfect al dente spaghetti.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for cooking perfect al dente spaghetti, including choosing high-quality spaghetti, using a large pot, using plenty of water, salting the water, bringing it to a boil then reducing heat, cooking for 7-9 minutes, checking frequently, reserving pasta water, and optionally rinsing the spaghetti.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested adding the homemade pasta sauce to the cooked spaghetti and tossing it to combine.
